issues.description: The problem statement and template explicitly instruct that, after computing the pixel memory address, the pixel value should be loaded into ECX (mov ecx, [esi]) so that the subsequent printf sequence (push ecx; push ebx; push eax; push message) prints the value from ECX. The provided solution instead loads the pixel value into EAX (mov eax, [esi]) at the corresponding place. This mismatch between the expected register (ECX) and the register used in the solution (EAX) is a structural inconsistency that will confuse students about which register should contain the pixel value and how the printf arguments are arranged.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the register usage consistent. Either (A) change the solution's load to mov ecx, [esi] at the calculation TODO so the pixel value is in ECX as the problem/template expect, or (B) update the template/problem instructions and the printf argument ordering to use EAX for the loaded pixel value (adjust pushes and comments accordingly). Prefer (A) to match the original problem instructions.
